name: wget-cloud-implementation
description: Product-managed backlog creation, epic delivery, architecture-safe implementation, and evidence-driven bugfix workflows for Wget Cloud.

interface.shortDescription: GitHub Project planning and multi-agent delivery.
interface.longDescription: Creates product-quality GitHub Project backlogs, executes epics and ordered task pools, coordinates planned implementation, and runs evidence-first bug repair with independent architecture, review, QA, GitOps, and approval gates across Wget Cloud repositories.
defaultPrompt: Use $wgc-task-creation to create a product-quality backlog in a selected GitHub Project.
Use $wgc-epic-implementation to deliver an epic or task pool from GitHub Project in dependency order.
Use $wgc-implementation for one planned task or $wgc-bugfix for an evidence-driven defect.
